description: Source code implementing classes and functions for managing user equipment (UE) slices in a RAN (Radio Access Network) context, including adding/removing UEs and logical channels, and calculating pending uplink bytes.

classes.name: slice_ue
classes.description: Represents a user equipment (UE) within a specific RAN slice, managing its logical channels and pending data.

classes.name: slice_ue_repository
classes.description: Manages a collection of UEs within a specific RAN slice, allowing addition, removal, and logical channel management.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the slice repository if it does not already exist.

methods.name: add_logical_channel
methods.description: Associates a logical channel with a UE within the slice, setting its LCID and LCG ID.

methods.name: rem_logical_channel
methods.description: Removes a logical channel from a UE within the slice, potentially removing the UE if no more bearers are active.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the slice repository.

methods.name: pending_ul_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Calculates the number of pending uplink bytes for new transmission, considering HARQ bytes and SR grants.
